rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who owns or runs a hotel, especially in casual speech.

example.english: The hotelier of that hotel even lives there to look after the business.
example.traditional: 嗰間酒店老闆自己都住埋喺酒店入面，方便照顧生意。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 zau2 dim3 lou5 baan2 zi6 gei2 dou1 zyu6 maai4 hai2 zau2 dim3 jap6 min6 fong1 bin6 ziu3 gu3 saang1 ji3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the hotelier is the manager rather than the owner.

example.english: The hotelier said there were no rooms available and asked us to come another day.
example.traditional: 酒店經理話而家冇空房，叫我哋改日再嚟。
example.jyutping: zau2 dim3 ging1 lei5 waa6 ji4 gaa1 mou5 hung1 fong4 giu3 ngo5 dei6 goi2 jat6 zoi3 lai4
